text: The IMF completed the third reviews under Seychelles’ Extended Fund Facility and Resilience and Sustainability Facility. Program performance remains good. Real GDP growth is projected at 4.3 percent in 2025, and average annual inflation is expected to reach 2.3 percent in 2025. IMF staff assess that macroeconomic stability has been maintained despite moderating growth in 2024. Staff recommend that authorities remain vigilant to inflationary pressures and adjust monetary policy if needed. Downside risks include tourism shocks, rising commodity prices, and climate change.
